mapper.sql: select m.session_id, s.title as session_title, coalesce(m.sender_user_id, r.message_sender_user_id, r.triggered_by_user_id, s.created_by_user_id) as user_id, m.created_at as sent_at from session_messages m join sessions s on s.session_id = m.session_id left join runs r on r.run_id = m.run_id where m.role = 'USER' and m.created_at >= #{startInclusive} and m.created_at < #{endExclusive} and coalesce(r.storage_mode, 'LEGACY_FULL') = 'LEGACY_FULL' and coalesce(r.source_type, m.source_type, 'MANUAL') = 'MANUAL' and coalesce(s.source_type, 'MANUAL') <> 'SIDE_QUESTION' union all select r.session_id, s.title as session_title, coalesce(r.message_sender_user_id, r.triggered_by_user_id, s.created_by_user_id) as user_id, r.created_at as sent_at from runs r join sessions s on s.session_id = r.session_id where r.storage_mode = 'REDIS_SUMMARY' and r.created_at >= #{startInclusive} and r.created_at < #{endExclusive} and coalesce(r.source_type, 'MANUAL') = 'MANUAL' and coalesce(s.source_type, 'MANUAL') <> 'SIDE_QUESTION'

sql.if: and (u.username ilike '%' || #{userKeyword} || '%' or u.unified_auth_id ilike '%' || #{userKeyword} || '%' or um.user_id ilike '%' || #{userKeyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
select um.user_id, coalesce(u.username, um.user_id, '未知用户') as username, um.session_id, um.session_title, count(*) as user_message_count, min(um.sent_at) as first_message_at, max(um.sent_at) as last_message_at from () um left join users u on u.user_id = um.user_id where 1 = 1
group by um.user_id, u.username, um.session_id, um.session_title order by last_message_at desc, user_message_count desc, um.session_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from ( select um.user_id, um.session_id from () um left join users u on u.user_id = um.user_id where 1 = 1
group by um.user_id, um.session_id ) grouped

select um.user_id, coalesce(u.username, um.user_id, '未知用户') as username, u.unified_auth_id, u.organization, u.rd_department, u.department, count(distinct um.session_id) as session_count, count(*) as user_message_count, min(um.sent_at) as first_message_at, max(um.sent_at) as last_message_at from () um left join users u on u.user_id = um.user_id where 1 = 1
group by um.user_id, u.username, u.unified_auth_id, u.organization, u.rd_department, u.department order by user_message_count desc, last_message_at desc, um.user_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from ( select um.user_id from () um left join users u on u.user_id = um.user_id where 1 = 1
group by um.user_id, u.username, u.unified_auth_id, u.organization, u.rd_department, u.department ) grouped
